xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4200: deps(desktop): electron-builder 26 + @electron/notarize 3 to clear the critical tar advisory

plan.title: deps(desktop): electron-builder 26 + @electron/notarize 3 to clear the critical tar advisory
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: bun audit reports one critical advisory (GHSA-23hp-3jrh-7fpw, tar <7.5.7). Both vulnerable copies are tar@6.2.1, pulled in only by electron-builder 25 (app-builder-lib 25 directly, and via @electron/rebuild 3.6.1 -> node-gyp 9 -> cacache 16). No patched tar 6.x exists. electron-builder 25 also carries the high AppImage search-path advisory GHSA-7g7r-gx96-252g, and the exact electron pin 40.6.0 carries ~35 Electron advisories fixed by 40.8.0+.
narratives.Proposal: Bump electron-builder to ^26.15.3 (app-builder-lib 26 uses tar ^7.5.7 and @electron/rebuild 4) and @electron/notarize to ^3.1.1; move electron's exact pin to 40.10.6. Keep the .cjs afterSign hook (Node 22.12+ require(esm) loads ESM-only notarize 3; verified on 22.22) and drop its notarize-2-only `tool` option; keep mac.notarize: false (still a boolean in electron-builder 26's schema and still skips built-in notarization). Guard the pins and hook with package-structure tests, document notarization in docs/BUILD.md, and prove the Linux AppImage builds and starts in a virgin environment.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Upgrading electron-updater or any other runtime dependency (the remaining builder-util-runtime <9.7.0 high advisory via electron-updater is a follow-up)
- Switching to electron-builder 26's built-in notarization or deleting the afterSign hook
- Renaming notarize.cjs to .mjs (only the documented await import() fallback inside the .cjs may change its load form)
- Changing afterPack.cjs
- Fixing other non-critical bun audit advisories (mermaid, react-router, vite, fastify, ...)
- Moving Electron to a new major or changing mac arch targets
- Adding mac or Windows packaging runs to local verification or CI
- Adding package overrides/resolutions to force transitive versions

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the afterSign hook as .cjs with a synchronous require of @electron/notarize 3
autoDecisions.rationale: Issue step 2 makes the .mjs rename conditional on Node 22 failing to load it; a scratch probe loaded notarize 3.1.1 via require() under Node v22.22.0 (require(esm), no top-level await), and CI setup-node 22 resolves to >=22.12. Fallback await import() documented as a checkpoint.

autoDecisions.summary: Remove the `tool: "notarytool"` option from the notarize() call
autoDecisions.rationale: notarize 3's NotarizeOptions has no tool field; the hook only runs on the macOS release runner and cannot be exercised locally, so it must not rely on the library ignoring unknown keys.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the hook's manual `xcrun stapler staple`
autoDecisions.rationale: notarize 2.5.0 already stapled internally, so the redundancy predates this change; re-stapling is harmless and changing an untestable release path buys nothing.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep mac.notarize: false plus the custom hook instead of electron-builder 26's built-in notarization
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches issue steps 2-3; the schema still types notarize as boolean and notarizeIfProvided returns early on false. Switching would make the @electron/notarize 3 devDependency dead weight.
26.15.3 is the npm latest dist-tag and >=26.15.0 (the AppImage fix); the caret resolves the newest 26.x (26.16.1 at planning time).
It is a runtime dependency shipped in the app and outside the issue's stated scope (0 critical); its builder-util-runtime high advisory is named in the PR body as a follow-up.

autoDecisions.summary: Record WI-6 verification evidence in an empty commit
autoDecisions.rationale: The verification changes no files but pan task done checks for an Item-trailer commit; an --allow-empty commit whose body lists the commands and results is durable evidence.

items.title: Bump electron-builder to ^26.15.3 and @electron/notarize to ^3.1.1

expected_outputs: bun audit summary shows 0 critical and no 'tar ' or 'app-builder-lib ' block

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1 (.pan/drafts/pan-4200.md). In apps/desktop/package.json devDependencies change "@electron/notarize": "^2.5.0" -> "^3.1.1" and "electron-builder": "^25.1.8" -> "^26.15.3". Do not touch dependencies (conf, electron-updater). Run bun install from the repo root and commit bun.lock. Expect two @electron/notarize entries in bun.lock afterwards (top-level 3.x plus app-builder-lib/@electron/notarize 2.5.0) - that is correct, add no overrides.

Drop the notarize-2 `tool` option from the afterSign hook and document its ESM loading

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3. In apps/desktop/scripts/notarize.cjs: remove the `tool: "notarytool",` line from the notarize() options (notarize 3's NotarizeOptions has no tool field); extend the comment above `const { notarize } = require("@electron/notarize");` to say notarize 3 is ESM-only and Node >= 22.12 loads it via require(esm). Keep the .cjs filename, keep execSync and the `xcrun stapler staple` call, keep the env-var gating. Do not edit package.json build.mac.notarize (stays false) or build.afterSign. CHECKPOINT: if the require check fails with ERR_REQUIRE_ESM, replace the require line with `const { notarize } = await import("@electron/notarize");` in the same .cjs file and re-run.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-5. In docs/BUILD.md, section `## Electron Desktop App (apps/desktop)`, insert `### macOS Signing and Notarization` immediately before `### Native Addon Rebuild`. State in prose: electron-builder 26, Electron exact-pinned 40.10.6 (bun update does not move exact pins); build.mac.notarize is false so built-in notarization is off; notarization runs in the afterSign hook apps/desktop/scripts/notarize.cjs only when APPLE_API_KEY (.p8 path), APPLE_API_KEY_ID and APPLE_API_ISSUER are all set (release workflow macOS runner), otherwise it logs a skip and the app ships signed but not notarized; @electron/notarize 3 is ESM-only and needs Node >= 22.12, loaded by the .cjs hook via require(esm); notarize() staples itself and the hook's extra xcrun stapler staple is harmless.

script prints 'health 200 on port

', 'Overdeck windows: 1', 'exited-code lines: 0'

narrative.Action: PRD WI-6. From the repo root run `bun run build:desktop:linux` (run `npm run build` first if server/frontend output is missing). Then run the PRD's virgin-launch script (env -i HOME=<scratch> PATH=/usr/bin:/bin inside one xvfb-run; poll /api/health on ports 7825-7834; count windows named Overdeck; count 'exited code' log lines; stop with pkill -f "mount_Overd[e]"). No files change: record the commands and results in an empty commit (git commit --allow-empty) carrying the Item trailer. If electron-builder 26 broke the AppImage (e.g. resources layout), fix it within this issue - a broken AppImage is not a follow-up.
